title: Player Eligibility for World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: This update clarifies the eligibility criteria for Indian junior players aiming to represent the nation at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: BAI has released guidelines regarding player eligibility for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, outlining the requirements for national representation.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Tournament Now World Junior Championships Selection Event
indian_angle: The Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been designated as the crucial selection event for Indian hopefuls eyeing a spot at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Following a postponement, the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament will now serve as the official selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026, replacing the Haryana tournament.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: Indian junior players in U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories will now compete under a new 3x15 scoring system in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups in all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships to align with international standards.

title: Grassroot Coaches Development Program Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This program aims to enhance coaching standards at the grassroots level across India, with sessions recently concluded at NCE Guwahati and Raipur.
summary: BAI conducted a Coaches Development Program for grassroots level coaches at National Centres of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from July 15th to 24th, 2026, focusing on skill enhancement.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues
indian_angle: Indian players and organizers are cautioned against participating in or promoting unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments not sanctioned by BAI.
summary: BAI has released an advisory warning players and stakeholders about participating in or organizing badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships that lack official sanction, to protect player interests.

title: Expression of Interest for BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: This EOI indicates India's potential involvement or bid to host the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, a major event for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued an Expression of Interest (EOI) related to the BWF World Championships 2026, signaling potential host city bids or significant organizational involvement.
